name: trip-copilot
description: Private single-owner business trip copilot: trip drafts, reminders, private-car planning, and travel context recommendations over the repository MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Plan private business trips with reminders and travel help.
interface.longDescription: Trip Copilot packages the middleproject business-trip MCP server (reminders, trip drafts, private-car planning, travel context recommendations) as a repository/team-private plugin for ChatGPT Developer Mode and Codex. Business logic stays in the backend application services; this plugin only describes how to drive the MCP tools safely. It is a single-owner demo: every request is served as the deployment-fixed Demo Owner, no user identity is accepted.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a business trip with reminders, private-car routing, and travel recommendations.
